compositions.title: Binding the animals
compositions.text: Twēgen męnn wǣron on ðǣm strande. Hīe hæfdon fīf dēor. Se ǣresta mann cwæð: “Gif ðū mē helpe, wē magon ðā dēor bindan.” Se ōðer mann cwæð: “Ic wille ðē helpan. Binden wē ðā dēor.” Hīe bundon ðā dēor, and se ǣresta mann sealde his gefēran męte. Ðā dēor wǣron bunden, and ðā męnn hæfdon męte.
audit_requests: Check every token and sense against actual prior IDs or explicit Unit7 teaching.
Check tentative present gif with subjunctive helpe and indicative modal main clause.
Check first-plural exhortation Binden wē and ordinary helpan dative.
Check final uninflected bunden with verbal passive; it is not an attributive neuter-plural target.
Verify story coherence: the first man seeks help, the second agrees, both bind the animals, the first gives the companion food.
Preserve the narrative’s stated participant reference without assuming every grammatical pronoun has a uniquely forced antecedent outside that context.

teaching_examples.text: Hīe swimmað on ðǣm sǣ. Swimmen hīe on ðǣm sǣ.
teaching_examples.purpose: Assertion and third-person wish; selected masculine sea.

teaching_examples.text: Hē mæg swimman. Hē mōt swimman. Swimme hē.
Gif hē hæfð męte, hē sęlð ðǣm fuglum męte.
teaching_examples.purpose: Open indicative condition; no automatic gif subjunctive rule.

teaching_examples.text: Gif ðū mē helpe, wē magon ðā dēor bindan.
teaching_examples.purpose: Tentative request for help, with subjunctive condition and indicative capability.

teaching_examples.text: Gif hē cōme, ic him hulpe.
teaching_examples.purpose: Recognition only: explicit unreal nonpast setting and supplied interpretation.

teaching_examples.text: Ðā dēor sindon bunden. Ðā dēor sindon bundene.
Se mann band ðæt dēor. Ðæt dēor wearð bunden.
teaching_examples.purpose: Active past event and passive with weorthan.

teaching_examples.text: Bēo geblētsod. Bēon ðā fuglas gemanigfielde.
teaching_examples.purpose: Singular passive command and plural passive wish.

teaching_examples.text: Ic hāte ðā fæstnesse Heofon. Bēo ðæt lēoht tō tācne.
teaching_examples.purpose: Two accusatives in naming; assigned function tō+dative.
